stepsClients.title: Post your project
stepsClients.description: Describe what you need, select the right category, add your budget, deadline, and key requirements. The more details you share, the easier it is for freelancers to understand your task and send relevant proposals.

stepsClients.title: Get proposals
stepsClients.description: Receive offers from freelancers who are interested in your project. Review their experience, suggested price, estimated timeline, and approach to understand who fits your needs best.

stepsClients.title: Choose a freelancer
stepsClients.description: Compare freelancer profiles, portfolios, ratings, reviews, and messages before making a decision. Choose the specialist who matches your project goals, budget, and communication style.

stepsClients.title: Start working
stepsClients.description: Discuss the final details, agree on the workflow, and begin your collaboration online. Stay connected with your freelancer and move your project from idea to result.

stepsFreelancers.title: Create your profile
stepsFreelancers.description: Add your skills, portfolio, and experience so clients can quickly see what you offer and why you're the right fit for their project.

stepsFreelancers.title: Find your project
stepsFreelancers.description: Browse open projects that match your expertise, or get recommendations tailored to your profile and past work.

stepsFreelancers.title: Send a proposal
stepsFreelancers.description: Share your price, timeline, and approach. A clear, personal proposal makes it easier for clients to choose you.

stepsFreelancers.title: Start working
stepsFreelancers.description: Agree on the details with your client and begin the project. Track progress and get paid securely as you go.

content.question: Is registration free?
content.answer: Yes, you can create an account for free. After signing up, you can set up your profile, browse freelancers or projects, and explore the platform before starting any collaboration.

content.question: How do I find a freelancer?
content.answer: Post a project or search the catalog by category, skill, or keyword, then compare profiles, portfolios, and reviews to pick the best fit.

content.question: How can freelancers find work?
content.answer: Complete your profile, add a portfolio, and browse open projects that match your skills, or wait for invitations from clients.

content.question: Can I work with clients online?
content.answer: Yes, messaging, file sharing, milestones and payments all happen online on the platform.

content.question: How do I post a project?
content.answer: Click “Post a Project”, describe your task, set a budget and deadline, and publish it to start receiving proposals.

content.question: What types of services can I find?
content.answer: Categories cover programming, design, marketing, copywriting, business support and more. The full list is on the Categories page.
